summary: Embedding re-rank of find's top 25 non-test files: weighted RRF, score = 1/(10+findRank) + w/(10+embRank), embRank from cosine of a code_query vector (daemon) vs each file's STORED sketch vector. Weights fixed from the pilot: 0.75 prose agent queries, 1.5 prompt-time injection, 0 identifier queries (queryShape = the pilot's own >= 40% id-like rule). Returns null — caller keeps today's order — when the embedder is off/not opted in, the store has vectors for < 50% of the eligible (sketchFilter) pool, or the query embed misses its budget (default 300 ms); on a daemon miss it fires ensureEmbedder() without waiting. Never embeds files (readers never build). Matched the offline dev harness 27/27 on coldstart prompts.
